description: Entry-point and file-shape contracts (spec sections 3 and 5.1).

contracts.title: Only `main() is int` and `async main() is int` are entry points; other forms are rejected before the body runs

aspects.boundary: n/a: the signature set is discrete; the async form is covered as normal

contracts.title: The entry result is an actual int in 0..255 used as the exit status; other values, types and missing results fail without wrapping or defaulting
Running a module requires an entry point

aspects.normal: n/a: every successful L00 program exercises a present main
aspects.boundary: n/a: the contract defines no boundary values distinct from its normal behaviour
aspects.interaction: n/a: imported mains are covered by MOD.IMPORT-MAIN-NOT-RUN

contracts.title: Every file starts with `module name;` or `module name vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH;` with lowercase /-separated names

aspects.interaction: n/a: no fragile cross-feature interaction is identified in the audited sources

contracts.title: Module scope holds declarations only; top-level statements are syntax errors

aspects.boundary: n/a: the contract defines no boundary values distinct from its normal behaviour
aspects.interaction: n/a: no fragile cross-feature interaction is identified in the audited sources

contracts.title: Imports follow the module declaration and precede other declarations

aspects.boundary: n/a: the contract defines no boundary values distinct from its normal behaviour
aspects.interaction: n/a: no fragile cross-feature interaction is identified in the audited sources
